import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'scripts'),str(ROOT/'tests')]
import cupy as cp
from gpu_resident_linear_test import matrices,captures,refusal
from gpu_coupled_world import GpuCoupledWorld,source_hash
assert matrices()['cases']==90
assert len(captures())==3
assert refusal()
for material in ('glass','oak','iron','ice'):
    world=GpuCoupledWorld(dict(material=material,height_m=.001,ball_mass_kg=.01,linear_backend='native-cusolver'))
    result=world.advance(1)
    assert result['time_s']>0
cp.cuda.get_current_stream().synchronize()
print('Native LU guards, changed-input graph replay, actual refusal and four material worlds passed '+source_hash(),flush=True)
